title: PARP1 inhibitors regulate PARP1 structure independent of DNA, reducing binding affinity for single strand breaks
authors: Mark Pailing; Lotte van Beek; Taiana Maia de Oliveira; Maria M. Flocco; Bart W. Hoogenboom
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AFM研究PARP1抑制剂在无DNA时诱导PARP1构象压实并降低其与单链断裂DNA的结合亲和力，涉及蛋白-DNA结合调控但非TF-DNA体系，且方法为实验观测而非AI或物理模拟，故评分为5。
abstract: Cancers caused by mutations to the DNA repair machinery may be treated by inhibitors that target Poly(ADP-ribose) Polymerase 1 (PARP1). PARP inhibitors are thought to cause toxicity by trapping PARP1 at single strand breaks, preventing single strand break repair, thus leading to accumulation of DNA damage and cancer cell death. Intriguingly though, different PARP inhibitors display similar cellular toxicities and catalytic inhibition despite having widely varying trapping potencies. To better understand this apparent contradiction and identify complementary mechanisms of action, we here visualize the effect of inhibitors on individual PARP1 and PARP2 molecules by atomic force microscopy (AFM). We find, surprisingly, that inhibitors cause significant PARP1 compaction and loss of molecular flexibility also in the absence of DNA. This compaction correlates with the trapping potency of the inhibitor; and could be functionally relevant by reducing the subsequent binding of pre-treated PARP1 to DNA. Such changes are less pronounced for PARP2, which shares a high sequence identity with the PARP1 catalytic domain but lacks the DNA binding domain present in PARP1. Our findings reveal an additional, DNA-independent mechanism of action for PARP inhibitors, where PARP inhibitors with strong trapping potencies target PARP1 in the absence of DNA, compact their conformation and thereby reduce its ability to bind to DNA.
abstract_zh: 由DNA修复机制突变引发的癌症，可通过靶向聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶1（PARP1）的抑制剂进行治疗。PARP抑制剂被认为通过将PARP1捕获在单链断裂处，阻止单链断裂修复，从而导致DNA损伤积累和癌细胞死亡，进而产生毒性。然而有趣的是，尽管不同PARP抑制剂在捕获效力上差异显著，它们却表现出相似的细胞毒性和催化抑制作用。为了更好地理解这一明显矛盾并识别互补的作用机制，我们在此通过原子力显微镜（AFM）可视化抑制剂对单个PARP1和PARP2分子的影响。我们惊讶地发现，即使在无DNA存在的情况下，抑制剂也会导致PARP1显著压缩和分子灵活性丧失。这种压缩与抑制剂的捕获效力相关；并可能通过减少预处理后的PARP1随后与DNA的结合而具有功能相关性。对于PARP2而言，这些变化不太明显，尽管PARP2与PARP1催化域具有高度序列同一性，但缺乏PARP1中存在的DNA结合域。我们的发现揭示了PARP抑制剂的一种额外、不依赖DNA的作用机制，其中具有强捕获效力的PARP抑制剂在无DNA存在时靶向PARP1，压缩其构象，从而降低其与DNA结合的能力。
